• Expected to nish work on integration and analyses by end of

Assessment Transition:
 NECAP to SBAC
 • SGP (student growth percentile) calculations are norm-
 referenced and so are scale agnostic, allowing calculation
 across different scales.

 • Signi cant oor/ceiling effects (> 5% student at lowest/
 highest obtainable scale score) will likely cause problems in
 calculation.

 • Even without oor/ceiling effects, communication challenges
 to stakeholders are likely to be an issue.

 • States discussing issues related to growth and assessment
 transition indicate communication as being the number one
 challenge.

Assessment Transition:
 NECAP to SBAC

• Two distinct challenges: Calculation and Use
• Just because we can calculate student growth doesn’t mean
 it is defensible to use it for previously existing accountability
 purposes.

• Validating growth use will require de ning the purpose.
• States are currently mapping out detailed timelines,
 preliminary analyses, and communication strategies for the
 use of assessment data during and following the assessment
 transition.
